#1 Setup
```{r Load Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r Load Data}
raw_data <- read_csv("../Data/mdv_sensor_data_2024.csv")


```
# Analysis
```{r Exploratory data analysis}
summary(raw_data)
glimpse(raw_data)

# Investigating unusual observations in data 
vwc0 <- filter(raw_data, `vwc_(m^3/m^3)` <= 0.0000)
ec0 <- filter(raw_data, `ec_(ds/m)` < 0)
# Removing observations where `vwc_(m^3/m^3)` <= 0.0000 or `ec_(ds/m)` < 0
clean_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!(`vwc_(m^3/m^3)` <= 0 | `ec_(ds/m)` < 0))

summary(clean_data)

```
